scope: Independent source review of frozen engine chronology, calibration, policies, development ranking and one-time evaluation guard; synthetic tests only.

test_results.scope: Synthetic frames, synthetic tiny estimator/calibrator fits, mocked input loading and temporary files.
Synthetic OHLCV, exact local V1 feature comparison, adversarial future changes, gaps, incomplete intrabar and ETH join cases.

independent_probes: Exact fit and calibration label_end equality boundaries are excluded; the rolling training start is respected and the three masks are disjoint.
Absolute confidence ties are inclusive; Q70/Q85 thresholds equal quantiles of past calibration confidence only; constant confidence abstains with threshold 2.0.
All 40 base recipes, 16 ensembles and 8 policies account for 448 development combinations.

Synthetic ranking enforces minimum-year accuracy before pooled accuracy, sample count before log-loss, log-loss before lexical ID, and rejects low samples, inactive months, concentrated months and failed recipes.
Modified policy threshold, member recipe, ensemble and group payloads are rejected after the guard fix; exclusive JSON creation refuses a second write.

passed_checks.features_and_labels: Only causal feature groups reach estimators. The target is the next candle close minus its own open. Doji predictions are retained and excluded only from binary fitting/scoring.
passed_checks.chronological_purge: fit label_end < calibration_start; calibration prediction_time >= calibration_start and label_end < quarter_start; all fold masks are disjoint. Training windows end before calibration.
passed_checks.preprocessing: Median imputation is inside each fitted pipeline. Logistic/SVC scaling is fitted only on the base training subset. HGB early stopping and SVC internal probability fitting are disabled.
passed_checks.calibration: V2 fits sigmoid calibration on the disjoint past 180-day subset. Nonpositive slope and single-class calibration use the fixed smoothed constant-rate rule. Convergence failures are logged and disqualify the recipe.
passed_checks.policies_and_ensembles: Six registered absolute thresholds and two past-calibration quantile rules are implemented. Ensembles average fixed member probabilities equally and derive thresholds from their own past calibration probability average.
passed_checks.development_selection: 2024 and 2025 are development only. Both years must meet the registered sample, active-month and concentration gates. The winner follows the exact declared ranking and all 448 combinations must be present.
passed_checks.freeze_integrity: Source/data hashes and ordered feature schemas are checked; completed batch artifacts are hashed. Selection parameters and ensemble membership are compared with settings, not only IDs.
passed_checks.one_time_evaluation: Frozen selection, development snapshots and ranking are verified before an exclusive run_started marker. Holdout hash/file access follows that marker. A prior marker blocks reruns including incomplete attempts.
passed_checks.evaluation_scope: Only the frozen selected members and the declared V1 control are fitted for Jan/Apr/Jul 2026. Earlier 2026 labels may enter later folds only through the same strict past-label masks. No holdout-based selection or switching is implemented.
passed_checks.v1_control: The 2022-01-01 slice is taken before rebuilding G1, preserving the original 96-bar warmup. The original scaler, C=.1 logistic, 90-day C=1e6 sigmoid and negative-slope behavior are retained.
passed_checks.reporting: Forecast, selected and scored counts are separated; controls use matching timestamps; monthly, quarterly and side tables are generated; fixed UTC 7-day block bootstrap is descriptive and excluded from selection.

resolved_findings.issue: The initial guard checked selected IDs but accepted altered policy thresholds or member parameters.
resolved_findings.resolution: validate_selection_payload now checks the complete registered policy, member recipes and ensemble. Synthetic tamper tests pass.

limitations: This review does not establish attainable accuracy or economic value; no real-data model outcome was examined.
No full real-data execution was performed in this review. Runtime and data-dependent numerical failures remain subject to the engine failure accounting.
The review applies to the exact hashes listed above. Any source/settings change requires review and a new pre-fit freeze.
Coverage is measured among the selected feature group eligible forecast rows; missing-input exclusions should remain visible when interpreting results.
The bootstrap is a descriptive interval conditional on the frozen recipe; it does not certify future accuracy or remove uncertainty from development model selection.
